orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
WPSS No. 777 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. M.C. Tewari, learned Deputy Advocate 
General has accepted notices on behalf of respondent 
Nos. 1 to 4. 
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate has accepted notice 
on behalf of respondent No. 5. 
Learned counsels for the respondents pray for 
and are granted four weeks’ time for filing counter 
affidavits. Thereafter, one week time is granted to the 
petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit, if any, thereto. 
List this matter on 20.05.2019. 
Having regard to the fact that the petitioner has 
been removed from service by stigmatic order, which 
has been passed without holding any inquiry, till the 
next date of listing, petitioner shall be allowed to work 
as Lab Technician and shall be paid due remuneration. 
Stay Application (CLMA No. 4223 of 2019) 
stands disposed of. 
Let certified copy of this order be supplied to the 
petitioner within 24 hours. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
02.04.2019
Aswal
